title: Rounding of provident fund contributions
description: How each provident fund, pension and insurance contribution is rounded, in its scheme's words: until 28 June 2026 the Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 1952, the Employees' Pension Scheme, 1995 and the Employees' Deposit-Linked Insurance Scheme, 1976, continued by section 164(2) of the Code on Social Security, 2020, and from 29 June 2026 the Schemes of 2026. The words read of the Scheme of 1995 round to the nearest rupee without saying where half a rupee goes. The rounding of the administrative charges was not read in an instrument.

choices.title: To the nearest rupee, fifty paise or more upwards

instruments: Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 1952, paragraph 29, Employees' Pension Scheme, 1995, paragraph 3(3), and Employees' Deposit-Linked Insurance Scheme, 1976, paragraph 7(2), as EPFO's consolidated texts print them, in force until the Schemes of 2026 superseded them on 29 June 2026

Code on Social Security, 2020 (36 of 2020), Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 1, No. 61, 29 September 2020: section 164(2), which keeps in force the schemes of the repealed Employees' Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952, in force from 21 November 2025 by S.O. 5319(E), 21 November 2025, as corrected by S.O. 5936(E), 19 December 2025

Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 2026, G.S.R. 525(E), 29 June 2026, Ministry of Labour and Employment, Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section (i), No. 473, superseding the Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 1952: “It shall come into force on the date of its publication in the Official Gazette.”; corrected by G.S.R. 703(E), 4 August 2026, No. 639

Employees' Pension Scheme, 2026, G.S.R. 527(E), 29 June 2026, Ministry of Labour and Employment, Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section (i), No. 475, superseding the Employees' Pension Scheme, 1995: “It shall come into force on the date of its publication in the Official Gazette.”; corrected by G.S.R. 704(E), 4 August 2026, No. 640

Employees' Deposit-Linked Insurance Scheme, 2026, G.S.R. 526(E), 29 June 2026, Ministry of Labour and Employment, Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section (i), No. 474, superseding the Employees' Deposit-Linked Insurance Scheme, 1976: “It shall come into force on the date of its publication in the Official Gazette.”

rows.source: Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 1952, paragraph 29, in EPFO's consolidated text, continued by section 164(2) of the Code on Social Security, 2020

cells.name: Provident Fund contributions
cells.wording: Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 1952, paragraph 29: Each contribution shall be calculated to the nearest rupee, 50 paise or more to be counted as the next higher rupee …

rows.source: Employees' Pension Scheme, 1995, paragraph 3(3), printed as 4(3) in EPFO's consolidated text, continued by section 164(2) of the Code on Social Security, 2020

cells.name: Pension Fund contributions of the employer and the Central Government
cells.wording: Employees' Pension Scheme, 1995, paragraph 3(3): Each contribution payable under sub-paragraphs (1) and (2) shall be calculated to the nearest rupee …

rows.source: Employees' Deposit-Linked Insurance Scheme, 1976, paragraph 7(2), in EPFO's consolidated text, continued by section 164(2) of the Code on Social Security, 2020

cells.name: Insurance Fund contributions
cells.wording: Employees' Deposit-Linked Insurance Scheme, 1976, paragraph 7(2): Each contribution shall be calculated to the nearest rupee, 50 paise or more to be counted as the next higher rupee and fraction of a rupee less than 50 paise to be ignored.

cells.name: Provident Fund contributions
cells.wording: Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 2026, paragraph 18(5): Each contribution shall be calculated to the nearest rupee, with fifty paise or more to be counted as the next higher rupee and fraction of a rupee less than fifty paise to be ignored.

cells.name: Pension Fund contributions of the employer and the Central Government
cells.wording: Employees' Pension Scheme, 2026, paragraph 4(3): Each contribution payable under sub-paragraphs (1) and (2) shall be calculated to the nearest rupee, fifty paise or more to be counted as the next higher rupee and fraction of a rupee less than fifty paise being ignored.

cells.name: Insurance Fund contributions
cells.wording: Employees' Deposit-Linked Insurance Scheme, 2026, paragraph 5(3): Each contribution shall be calculated to the nearest rupee, fifty paise or more to be counted as the next higher rupee and fraction of a rupee less than fifty paise to be ignored.
